t: BWT Water Softener Block Salt is an essential plumbing supply for maintaining efficient water softener systems. This 8kg pack contains two 4kg salt blocks, providing a convenient and effective solution for preventing limescale accumulation. It is compatible with all leading makes of block salt water softeners, making it a versatile choice for plumbers and heating engineers. Regular use helps to protect boilers, hot water cylinders, and appliances from hard water damage, ensuring their longevity and optimal performance in residential and commercial properties.
